description: Open a Microsoft Publisher .pub file and get its text and photographs back as a PDF. The page reproduces the original layout; this endpoint returns the text in reading order, not the design. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

data.description: The .pub file's bytes, base64-encoded. Publisher files are OLE2 compound documents; a .docx or .pdf sent here is refused rather than guessed at.

name.description: What to call the result. The extension is replaced with .pdf.

page.description: Paper for the result. 'a4' and 'letter' re-flow the words onto a sheet of that size. 'same' asks to keep the document's own page size and layout — which this endpoint cannot do yet, so it answers with the A4 re-flow and says so in 'layoutUnavailable'. The page itself is kept in the browser, at helpyself.com/pub-to-pdf/.

pictures.description: Keep the pictures the file carries — photographs, and the clip art Publisher stores as drawings, which are redrawn. Off returns the words only, which is what somebody pasting a parish magazine into an email wants.

name: pub_to_pdf
title: PUB to PDF
